content.comment_body: Hello, I'm new to [product_name] PLCs and I have this hardware setup: [product_name] [article_no] with Ethernet and micro SD, and the PT100 module [article_no]. When I connect via Ethernet the device is detected, but in [product_name] programming software, I can only choose between two versions: [version_no] or [version_no]. Which one should I select? I tried [version_no] and was able to connect, but after transferring a sample program from PC to PLC, when I run the PLC, it shows an error saying the program is empty. Can someone help me? Also, I need to know how to view the analog signal from the module in the programming software. Thanks, [user_name]

Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. Your module is the latest [product_name] and appears in the hardware selection as [product_name] [version_no]. For this module, you need [product_name] programming software version [version_no] or newer. It's best to upgrade to the latest version. You can download the update here: [document]. The complete package is about 1.3 GB. After downloading, run the setup as an administrator.

Here’s an example of how to read input from the PT100 module in the [product_name] program and configure it with a decimal for display. Since two analog inputs (AI1 and AI2) are allocated by default to the main module, the first available channel on the expansion module is AI3.

analysis.insight_summary: New users are unsure which hardware version to select in the programming software, causing issues with program transfer and execution. There is a lack of clear instructions for viewing and configuring analog inputs from expansion modules. Finding information about software compatibility is not simple for beginners.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an intuitive workflow for hardware selection, smooth program transfer and execution, and straightforward options for monitoring analog inputs from additional modules within the software.
